documents.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

review_notes: The store sells an "H2C (Right Hotend)" Printer Model option (its own hero images FAH054-FAH056, unlike FAH063-FAH065 of every other printer). The wiki says the H2/P2S hotend fits the H2C left hotend only and that the H2C right nozzle is the Vortek induction hotend (separate product, Max. Printing Temp 350 ℃). Product-scope store values (length 49.2 mm, package 60x60x30 mm, 28 g) and the 0.4 mm flow figures may not hold for those three variants; nothing here is scoped to that option value.
No official in-the-box list was found in the documents read, so in_the_box is empty and package.contents is not_published.
